description: This Java class 'BinaryProtocolCmdSandbox' provides a command-line utility that initializes serial communication with a specified port, sets up a binary protocol, reads configuration images, and interacts with external tools like RomRaider and ECUEditor for further processing.

classes.name: BinaryProtocolCmdSandbox
classes.description: Main class providing command-line interface to initialize serial communication, perform a binary protocol exchange, and launch external ECU and configuration image tools.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for executing serial port setup, binary protocol initialization, reading configuration, and launching ECU image viewer.

methods.name: doShowImage
methods.description: Method to display the ConfigurationImage using external ECU editor after verifying protocol definition.
